api_contract.time_struct_from_in: struct ds3231_time drv; drv.seconds = in->seconds; drv.minutes = in->minutes; drv.hours = in->hours; drv.day = in->day; drv.date = in->date; drv.month = in->month; drv.year = in->year; drv.weekday = in->weekday;
api_contract.init_extra_setup_c: int fd = open(bus_name, O_RDWR); if (fd < 0) return DRIVERGEN_EVAL_ERR_IO; g_eval_dev.fd = fd;

test_stimuli.name: nominal_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: seconds=0x59=59, minutes=0x30=30, hours=0x15=15, day=0x03=3, date=0x15=15, month=0x06=6, year=0x24=24 -> year+2000=2024

test_stimuli.name: zero_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: seconds=0x00=0, minutes=0x00=0, hours=0x00=0, day=0x01=1, date=0x01=1, month=0x01=1, year=0x00=0 -> year+2000=2000
